meta.notes: Live Magento scrape of Nintendo AU Current Offers via headless Chrome. Steam via storesearch + appreviews (English overall) + appreviewhistogram (recent ~30d) + appdetails genres + SteamSpy tags. Inclusion: keep if overall OR recent is Overwhelmingly Positive / Very Positive. rogue_flag from significant SteamSpy tags (top~12 / ≥35% of top-tag votes) + known lists; Action Roguelike→roguelite; Traditional Roguelike→roguelike; both when both significant. Duplicate Steam apps collapsed to cheapest AU offer.
